messages.en:
I can't wait until we can
hang out again!
messages.et:
Ootan juba, millal saame
jälle koos olla!

messages.en:
Yesterday's enemy, today's
ally! 'Til we meet again!

I want to rock out to
{04 11 00} with you!

You're coming back, right?
I can't wait forever!
messages.et:
Sa tuled ju tagasi?
Ma ei saa igavesti oodata!

messages.en:
Wait until you see my
super secret power move!
messages.et:
Oota, kuni näed mu
supersalajast jõuliigutust!

messages.en:
Come visit again whenever
you want! We'll be waiting!
messages.et:
Tule jälle külla, millal
tahad! Me ootame!

messages.en:
We'd like to visit you, but
we just can't.
messages.et:
Tahaksime sulle külla
tulla, aga lihtsalt ei saa.

messages.en:
When you're all trained
up, come visit us again!
messages.et:
Kui oled end vormi
treeninud, tule jälle!

messages.en:
You should come back, if
only for a short visit.
messages.et:
Sa peaksid tagasi tulema,
kasvõi lühikeseks ajaks.

messages.en:
I know you want to come
visit us soon! I know it!
messages.et:
Tean, et tahad meile
varsti külla tulla! Tean!

messages.en:
I can't cram my muscles
into this. It's yours now!
messages.et:
Ma ei suru oma lihaseid
siia sisse. Võta sina!

messages.en:
I want you to have this.
Check it out! We match!
messages.et:
Tahan, et sa selle saaksid.
Vaata! Oleme ühesugused!

messages.en:
This is for you. It's a
going-away present.
messages.et:
See on sulle. See on
hüvastijätukingitus.

messages.en:
You sound like you need a
treat from {04 17 00}!

Remember this? You ran
out, right?
messages.et:
Mäletad seda? Sul sai
otsa, eks?

messages.en:
This is yours now. Don't
worry about it! Take it!
messages.et:
See on nüüd sinu. Ära
muretse! Lihtsalt võta!
